messages:
Ava (Marketing): Quick sync — draft copy for the tri-mode landing pilot. Goal: make Hosted feel fastest-to-start, Dedicated feel enterprise-grade, Private feel locked-down. Need hero lines, a concise benchmark blurb for the hero, webinar gating copy, and clear inbound lead routing. Quick reactions pls.
Diego (Growth): love the framing. prioritize 1) hero clarity 2) benchmark proof 3) CTA variations for webinar vs demo.
Priya (Content): For hero microcopy I sketched 3 options: 
- Hosted: 'Start building with a single API — low friction, instant results.'
- Dedicated: 'Reserved capacity, predictable performance for production scale.'
- Private: 'On-prem or VPC — full control, compliance-ready.'
Keep them 6–9 words each.
Sam (Demand Gen): Webinar gating: two tracks inside the form — "Get started (self-serve)" vs "Enterprise walkthrough". If they pick Enterprise, route to AE. If they pick Self-serve, send webinar recording + onboarding checklist.
Jordan (Sales Ops): +1. We should map inbound to Salesforce queues. Proposed routing YAML (for engineers/platform):
```yaml
incoming_path: /signup
form_fields:
  product_mode: [hosted, dedicated, private]
routing:
  hosted:
    queue: inbound_onsite_hosted
    notify: growth@redwood.ai
  dedicated:
    queue: dedicated_sales_queue
    notify: ae-team@redwood.ai
  private:
    queue: enterprise_ops_queue
    notify: enterprise@redwood.ai
```
Jordan (Sales Ops): Also include a hidden field 'benchmark_interest=true' when they click the benchmark CTA so SDRs can prioritize.
Ava (Marketing): Nice. For the hero benchmark blurb — we have 2 recent datapoints: median P95 latency 90ms on Hosted for short prompts, and 40% lower per-token cost using our batching profile vs baseline. Draft blurb: 'Real-world: 90ms P95, 40% lower per-token costs with Redwood Optimize.' Too clunky?
Diego (Growth): tighten: 'Real-world P95 90ms · 40% lower per-token cost'. Use middle dot. Short and scannable.
Priya (Content): For the webinar sign-up microcopy: 'Join our workshop: live benchmarks, migration checklist, and a live Q&A with engineering.' CTA text options: 'Save my spot' / 'Request enterprise walkthrough' / 'Watch on demand' (for post-webinar).
Sam (Demand Gen): On the landing page we should A/B test two routes: A) benchmark-first hero + webinar CTA B) product-first hero + start-button. Hypothesis: Benchmark-first drives higher qualified signups from platform teams.
Ava (Marketing): Good call. Let's include tracking params: ?utm_campaign=launch-copy-pilot&utm_variant=bench-hero. Sam can own experiment setup.
Sam (Demand Gen): Will do. I'll wire experiment in GA/Amplitude and pass tracking to Growth.
Jordan (Sales Ops): For routing, flag any capture with company_size > 1000 as high-touch — auto-assign to AE and add to calendar propose queue.
Priya (Content): Microcopy for Private page security line: 'Bring Redwood into your VPC or air-gapped environment — KMS/HSM integrations and audit logs included.' Keep it short.
Ava (Marketing): Next steps: Priya finalize hero + webinar microcopy today. Diego set up the A/B in Growth stack. Sam create tracking and experiment pages. Jordan create SF routing rules + notify template. I'll draft final landing wire with sections and share for one last pass.
lifecycle-bot: New benchmark upload: "hosted-short-prompts-v2" available at /benchmarks/hosted-short-prompts-v2 — pinged @Ava @Diego.
Diego (Growth): Nice, will use that bench in variant A.
Priya (Content): I pushed copy to the drive: /Marketing/launch-copy-pilot/drafts. Link: https://drive.redwood.ai/launch-copy-pilot. Feedback welcome.
Ava (Marketing): Thanks team — copy review at 3pm. If anyone can't make it, drop comments on the drive and I'll sync changes. :raised_hands:
